C9000205.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 205 (Saxl’s conjecture and universal tensor squares.; papers: Universal Tensor Squares for Symmetric Groups; A Cyclic Polytabloid Proof of Saxl's Conjecture; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/205.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_SAXL.statement: For every m>=1 and lambda partition of m(m+1)/2, g(rho_m,rho_m,lambda)>0 (companion thm:saxl).

C_CYCLIC_STAIRCASE.statement: The specified triangular row-column cyclic module W_m contains every irreducible at the triangular degree (thm:cyclic-saxl).

C_DOMINATED.statement: W_m contains all lambda dominated by rho_m (prop:dominated; signed averaging, coordinate quotient, Young rule).

C_COORDINATE_INDUCTION.statement: A cyclic generator in one of disjoint transitive coordinate sectors generates the full induced module (lem:sector-induction in both papers).

C_BAND_QUOTIENT.statement: W_m surjects onto Ind(W_(m-s) external U_(m,s)), s=1,2, by the forced marked triangle (prop:band-quotient).

C_BAND_TWO.statement: For m>=3 the specified U_(m,2) contains every partition of 2m-1 with at most four rows (prop:two-band).

C_STRIP_REDUCTION.statement: A target outside staircase dominance admits a horizontal m-strip, or m>=5 and at most four strips totalling 2m-1 (comb:strip-reduction).

C_UNIVERSAL.statement: For every n>=1 except 2,4,9 there is one lambda partition of n whose square contains every irreducible (universal thm:main).

C_CANDIDATE.statement: The parity-compatible enlarged staircase L is self-conjugate of degree n; parameter bounds hold; M<9 implies n<=64 (lem:candidate).

C_TRIANGLE_QUOTIENT.statement: The enlarged cyclic module surjects onto Ind(W_(M-2) external U_F), reducing support to a contained complement diagram (band:triangle-quotient).

C_ATTACHMENTS.statement: The two separated attachments jointly supply every even-column diagram of area 2r and at most eight columns (band:one-extra, band:two-extras).

C_SEPARATION.statement: Endpoint placement forces separated path and attachment contractions with no cancelling surviving terms (band:separated and proof of prop:band-test).

C_BAND_TEST.statement: The three explicit d,q capacity inequalities imply target support in the fixed enlarged square (prop:band-test).

C_BALANCE.statement: A first-four row or column sum <=2M-2 implies target support (prop:balance-four).

C_BALANCE_SECTORS.statement: Size-and-sum coordinate separation, two-path and symmetric-pair components give the required local balanced supports (lem:balance-separation, bal:two-paths, bal:even-rows, bal:odd-strip).

C_THREE_ROW.statement: The short three-row component has the asserted support (prop:three-row).

C_CAPACITY.statement: Band and balance exhaust every target for all admissible M>=9,r>0, using large-M bounds and intermediate/19 exceptional exact cases (prop:capacity-exhaustion).

C_CAPACITY_BOUNDS.statement: Rectangle and floor bounds force area contradiction for M>=22 (lem:capacity-rectangle, lem:capacity-large).

C_CAPACITY_FINITE.statement: The intermediate and exceptional finite capacity checks are exhaustive and sound, including prefix pruning and hit tests (capacity section).

C_FINITE64.statement: For all eligible degrees <=64, an exact character-residue computation certifies a universal self-conjugate square (prop:finite-check). Not replayed in this mission.

C_SPECHT_INPUTS.statement: Complex Specht irreducibility, self-duality, sign conjugacy, and semisimplicity used for the representation-theoretic interpretation.

C_INDUCTION_INPUTS.statement: Pieri/Littlewood-Richardson, branching, Frobenius reciprocity, and Young support used outside the integer core.

C_ODD_PATH_MANUSCRIPT.statement: For every odd length and ordered column list <=4, some common test basis gives nonzero contraction; finitely many lists admit one generic basis (band:path-support).

C_ODD_PATH_UNIFORM.statement: The single integral conjugator Q=[[1,1],[1,2]] makes the actual fixed-endpoint odd-path contraction equal epsilon times product r_j!, epsilon in {-3,-1,1,3}, for every ordered list r_j in {1,2,3,4} of positive odd total length.

L_PATH_INDEX_BRIDGE.statement: The actual two-layer alternating coefficient sum with fixed endpoint letters equals (-1)^t times the (1,1) entry of the alternating matrix/adjugate product (path:contraction).

L_COLUMNS_DISTRIBUTE.statement: Independent dual column alternations in consecutive segments factor into the ordered product of their alternating matrices, without interchanging factors.

L_SEGMENT_ALTERNATION.statement: All eight length/start-parity alternating segment identities hold with the stated factorial and signs (path:segment).

L_UNIFORM_ENDPOINT.statement: Every product of normalized segment matrices is a signed member of {I,Z,T,J}; after the fixed conjugation its (1,1) entry is in {-3,-1,1,3}.

L_GENERATOR_SIGN.statement: Increasing path index reverses exactly m-1 column-pair orders, so u=(-1)^(m-1)u_(m,2) (path:generator-sign).

C_LIT_BWZ.statement: Ambient multiplicity-free four-row support of the two-row square is Corollary 4.1 of Brown-van Willigenburg-Zabrocki (2010), not itself a cyclic-generator result.
